facts.business: Kwality Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company engaged in the manufacturing and export of formulations and APIs, with a focus on regulated and semi-regulated markets, oncology, hormones, and biologics/biosimilars.

capacity_or_capex.item: Dedicated hormone manufacturing facility and capacity enhancement in oncology and biologics with advanced automation

guidance_or_targets.statement: Revenue target for FY27 raised to over ₹700 crore from earlier guidance of ₹650 crore
Long-term goal to double revenue over next three years to ₹1,000 crore plus by FY29
Erythropoietin (Kwalipoietin) biologic on track for planned CY2027 launch subject to regulatory approvals

key_risks: Geopolitical conflicts in Middle East and West Asia disrupting supply chains and delaying customer payments
Elevated debtor days (208 days in FY26) impacting cash conversion cycle
Regulatory approval delays for new product launches (e.g., Erythropoietin CY2027 launch subject to approvals)
Patent expiry dependency for biosimilar market entry (three mAbs under global patent protection)
Implementation risks from new Labour Codes (29 laws consolidated) with incremental financial impact
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances from related parties: Unsecured - Nil as at 31st March 2026 and 31st March 2025. Shareholding in subsidiary Kwality Pharmaceuticals Africa Limitada: Kwality Pharmaceuticals Limited 51%, Mr. Rajendra Singh Golan 49%.
